pass_a_gloss: Do not be ashamed of Christ before the nations. Love God with the whole soul. Remember the contest set before you.
pass_b_english: [[Do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord >> Bible:2 Timothy 1:8]]. Love God with the whole soul, and keep in mind the contest set before you, as athletes of a better crown.
